designer.ai.welcome: Ask proposes a layout change for you to review and apply. Agent drafts a fix and writes it onto the canvas — nothing is saved until you click Save.
designer.ai.placeholder: Ask to add a control, explain this layout, or change the canvas…
designer.ai.disabled: AI is disabled in platform settings.
designer.ai.noModels: Enable a chat-capable AI model in AI settings.
designer.ai.pendingHint: Review this layout, then click Apply. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
designer.ai.toolsRequired: Agent mode needs a model with Tools capability. Pick one in the model menu, or switch to Ask.
designer.ai.noLayoutApplied: The canvas is unchanged — this turn only investigated (e.g. looked up an API or schema) without drafting a layout. Reply with something like "now draft it" to have the agent act on what it found, or switch to Ask mode for a proposed patch you can Apply.
